title: The angels who visited Abraham and Lot in Sodom as beautiful Nordic-like men

tellings.quote: And uh they they did look particularly beautiful because the one who goes to Sodom to retrieve Lot

plain: The angels who visit Abraham in the Bible, and the one who goes to Sodom to bring Lot out, looked especially beautiful, says the researcher Jason Jorjani. He tells Michels this without naming a source and reads them as tall, fair, "Nordic"-looking men. Read that way, the Genesis story would describe visitors who were human-looking beings, not spirits.
